title: 第20章 立威第21章 加倍奉还

第二十章 立威
乾劲兴奋的起了一身鸡皮疙瘩，魔铸师啊！就算是实力强大的战士，以及魔法师们，见到了魔铸师也绝不会摆什么架子，同样要上前恭敬的喊一声大师。
便是有着强大势力的家族甚至帝国，也同样会开出无数优厚的条件进行招揽，去了那可不是一般的家臣或者朝臣。
魔铸师！走到哪里，都是供奉！可以说是那种只拿钱不干活的特殊地位，心情好的时候随便打造点小玩意，就能乐得家族跟帝国开心的不得了。
“魔铸师，哈哈！”乾劲开心的连连摇头：“说起来，就算在乾家我也只是听说供奉着魔铸师，却从来没见过呢。如果我真的有一天可以成为魔铸师……”
乾劲的口水，控制不住的流了出来。
一个金币，往日里在其他商店打工一个月时间，也才只能够拿到一个金币的报酬。
乾劲很开心，短短的时间提着打铁锤用力敲打一通，就赚到了一个金币的收入，走起路来的脚下都感觉轻松，嘴里吹着扣上走进布店，挑了一块适合做床单的布匹，没有再像往日那样为了一个铜板，跟商店的大妈讨价还价半天，而是直接付钱走人。
帽子！乾劲满脑子都是那顶把自己砸成了‘长相犯罪’的帽子，以及随之而来的那叫做【无尽世界】的游戏。
仅仅只是在里面被蹂躏的打铁而已，出来打水变得如此轻松，掰腕子更是直接把同年龄中蛮力第三的鲁迪当小孩子一样随便赢，就连那个从来不收奥克兰魔法与战士学院学生的铁匠铺，也宛如对待上宾一样的对待自己。
这一切，都是因为那个古怪的帽子！乾劲吹着口哨，脚步加快的回到学校，想要看看【无尽世界】中到底还有什么。
穿过一栋栋住宅，乾劲穿行在自己所处的房间门外长廊，发现几个同处长廊的其他房间学员，正拿怪异的眼神，偷偷从门缝盯着自己。
“这是怎么回事？”乾劲很是奇怪，难道‘长相犯罪’这个倒霉的事情，已经到了所有人都知道的地步了吗？
房门是开着的，准确的说不是被人推开的，而是被人踹开的。
不久前还完整的门板，如今变成了大小不等的几块木板，安静的躺在地上，房间中还有过一翻挣扎的痕迹，去食堂盛饭用的饭盆安静的躺在地上，被人用脚踩的变形，还有那用来喝水的杯子，也已经摔在地上摔得粉碎。
小偷？抢劫？乾劲站在房门外看着满地的狼籍，脑海中第一个反应便是帽子，迈腿连忙走入房间。
帽子，还一如离开时的样子，被绑在床板的下面，没有半分的损坏。
乾劲起身再次打量着房间，一切的东西都没有丢失，杯子跟饭盆从房间的情况来看，显然是有人在这里进行挣扎跟反抗的时候，留下的痕迹。
至于小偷跟抢劫？乾劲摇摇头，除非小偷或者抢劫犯不想活了，却又没有自杀的勇气，才会进入奥克兰魔法与战士学校来行窃，这里可是培养日后上战场杀魔族的学校，战士学员跟魔法学员们，不介意把坏人当做魔族给干掉。
平日用来摆放碗筷的桌面，放着一封信，上面写着《乾劲亲启》。寥寥的几个字，透着一股浮躁的情绪。

【罗林在我手上，你如果敢还不来学院后面的小树林，就去医院找你的朋友吧！】凯萨斯。
乾劲抓着手中的字迹潦草的纸张用力狠狠咬了下嘴唇，这小子是不是疯掉了？上次揍的他还不够重吗？这罗林也是的，喜欢谁不行？偏偏去追什么校花朱礼丝，那个女人骄傲的跟孔雀一样，追她干什么？
乾劲看了看罗林的床，又看了看自己的床，当日自己刚刚来到这学校时，几乎到了一个铜板都没有的地步，如果不是罗林时不时的接着跟自己打赌，故意输钱支援生活费，恐怕练功的时间都没了，全部时间都去打工养活自己了。
独立之后，乾劲才发现，原来生活并不是一件容易的事情，只是当时既然已经选择了离开，遇到再难的事情也要挺直了脊梁，活出个人样来。
乾劲丢掉手中字迹潦草的纸张，转身向门外走去，罗林是这学校唯一的朋友，而且还对自己有不小的恩情，作为男人一定要恩怨分明。作为战士，在遇到挑战时更不该退缩。
“小树林是吗？”乾劲走在长廊，无视周围其他同学那同情的眼神，轻轻耸着肩膀自言自语：“行！今天就借着你立威，让那些整天打我排名主意的人老实点。”
乾劲很快消失在了长廊尽头，转身走出了学生宿舍的范围。躲藏在各自房间的学员们望着乾劲消失的位置连连摇头，这次乾劲可真的要倒霉了，他或许还不知道吧？凯萨斯根本没打算跟他做战士之间的一对一战斗，而且听说他花大价钱，请动了一年级战士学员中排名第八的左伦天刃，那可是排名实力还在乾劲之上的人，一手魔猿兽斗技就连老师都对他称赞不已。
左伦天刃，那可不是凯萨斯那样的货色。几个胆大的战士学员，略微犹豫了一下跟着乾劲消失的方向跑去，年级排名前十的战斗，那可并非那么容易就能看到，不知道乾劲面对排名在他之上的战士，能撑多久才会战败呢？
奥克兰魔法与战士学院的后院，是一个占地不小的大土包，用来形容是一座小山也不为过，上面种植满了各种各样的树木，最初的目的是让学员们对环境的一种模拟训练，毕竟任何学员都可能会走上对抗魔族的战争前线，来保护大多数人的安全，多一种环境练习还是好事。
如今，这座长满了树木，形成树林的小山丘，更多的则成为了学生们私下解决恩怨的地方。

Chapter 20 Establishing Prestige
I was so excited that I got goosebumps all over my body, Magic Caster! Even powerful warriors and magicians will never put on any airs when they see the Magic Caster. They will also step forward and respectfully call Master.
Even powerful families and even empires will also offer countless favorable conditions to recruit them, and they are not just ordinary retainers or courtiers.
Magic Caster! Wherever you go, there are offerings! It can be said that it is a special status that only takes money and does not work. When you are in a good mood, you can just build some gadgets and make your family and empire happy.
"Magic Caster, haha!" Gan Jin shook his head happily: "Speaking of which, even in the Qian family, I have only heard that the Demon Caster is enshrined, but I have never seen one. If I really can become a Magic Caster one day..."
Drool flowed out uncontrollably.
One gold coin. In the past, if you worked in other stores for a month, you could only get one gold coin as payment.
I was very happy because I hit hard with a hammer in a short period of time and earned one gold coin. My feet felt relaxed when I walked. I walked into the cloth shop with a button in my mouth and picked a piece of cloth suitable for making sheets. Instead of haggling with the store aunt for a long time for a copper plate like in the past, I just paid and left.
hat! All I can think about is the hat that made me look like a criminal, and the game called [Endless World] that followed.
It was just a blacksmith who was being ravaged inside, but it became so easy to come out to fetch water. In arm wrestling, Rudy, who was third in brute strength among his age, was beaten as casually as a child. Even the blacksmith shop that never accepted students from the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors treated him like an honored guest.
All this is because of that weird hat! Whistling energetically, he walked back to school quickly, wanting to see what else there was in the [Endless World].
After walking through the houses one after another, Gan Jin walked through the corridor outside the door of the room he was in, and found several students from other rooms who were in the same corridor, secretly staring at him through the crack in the door with strange eyes.
"What's going on?" Qian Jin was very strange. Could it be that the unfortunate thing of 'looking criminal' has reached the point where everyone knows about it?
The door was open. To be precise, it wasn't pushed open, but kicked open.
The door panel that was intact not long ago has now turned into several wooden boards of different sizes, lying quietly on the ground. There are still traces of a struggle in the room. The rice bowl used to serve food in the canteen is lying quietly on the ground, deformed by being stepped on, and the cup used for drinking water has also been smashed to pieces on the ground.
Thief? robbery? Ganjin stood outside the door and looked at the mess on the floor. The first thing that came to his mind was the hat, and he hurriedly walked into the room.
The hat was still the same as when he left it, tied under the bed board, without any damage.
He stood up and looked around the room again. Nothing was missing. Judging from the condition of the cup and rice bowl, it was obvious that there were traces left when someone struggled and resisted here.
As for thieves and robberies? Ganjin shook his head. Only thieves or robbers who don't want to live anymore but don't have the courage to commit suicide will enter the Oakland School of Magic and Warriors to steal. This is a school that trains people to kill demons on the battlefield in the future. Warrior students and magic students don't mind killing bad guys as demons.
On the table where the dishes and chopsticks are usually placed, there is a letter with the words "Qian Jin Qin Qi" written on it. The few words conveyed an impetuous mood.
[I have Luo Lin in my hand. If you dare not come to the woods behind the college, go to the hospital to find your friends! 】Caesas.
He grabbed the scrawled paper in his hand vigorously and vigorouslyBiting his lower lip, has this kid gone crazy? Wasn't the beating he received last time hard enough? This is Luo Lin too, who can't he like? Why are you chasing the school beauty Zhu Lisi? That woman is as proud as a peacock. Why are you chasing her?
Ganjin looked at Luo Lin's bed and then at his own bed. When he first came to this school that day, he almost didn't have a single coin. If Luo Lin hadn't bet with him from time to time and deliberately lost money to support his living expenses, he would have lost all his time to practice and would have spent all his time working to support himself.
After becoming independent, Gan Jin discovered that life was not an easy thing. However, since he had chosen to leave at that time, he had to straighten his spine and live his own life no matter how difficult things were.
Gan Jin threw away the scrawled paper in his hand, turned around and walked out the door. Luo Lin was the only friend in this school, and he also had a lot of kindness towards him. As a man, he must keep his grudges clear. As a warrior, you should never back down when faced with challenges.
"Is it a small forest?" Ganjin walked in the corridor, ignoring the sympathetic eyes of other students around him, lightly shrugging his shoulders and saying to himself: "Okay! I will use you to establish my authority today to make those who have been thinking about my ranking all day long be honest."
The energy quickly disappeared at the end of the corridor, turned around and walked out of the student dormitory. The students hiding in their respective rooms looked at the place where Gan Jin disappeared and shook their heads. This time Gan Jin was really going to be in trouble. Maybe he didn't know it yet? Kesas had no intention of engaging him in a one-on-one battle between warriors, and I heard that he spent a lot of money to recruit Zuolun Tianren, who was ranked eighth among the first-year warrior students. He was a person whose ranking strength was still higher than his motivation. Even his teacher praised him for his magic ape fighting skills.
Zuolun Tianren, that is not something like Kaisas. Several brave warrior students hesitated slightly and ran in the direction where Ganjin disappeared. A battle among the top ten in the grade is not that easy to see. I wonder how long Ganjin can last against the warriors ranked above him before being defeated?
The backyard of the Oakland Academy of Magic and Warriors is a large dirt bag that occupies a large area. It is not an exaggeration to describe it as a hill. It is planted with various trees. The original purpose is to give students a simulated training in the environment. After all, any student may go to the front line of the war against the demons to protect the safety of most people. It is good to have another kind of environment to practice.
Today, this small hill covered with trees, forming a forest, has become more of a place for students to settle their grievances privately.
